# CompBioBench v1: A benchmark of 100 diverse, verifiable questions for agents for computational biology

We introduce CompBioBench v1, a benchmark of 100 diverse tasks for evaluating agentic systems in computational biology. Unlike mathematics and programming, which more readily admit systematic verification, biological data are inherently noisy and open to interpretation.
